pack.name: Funding Agency Automation Pack
pack.persona: Funding brokers, ISOs, referral partners, broker VAs, processors, and consultants adding business funding offers
pack.description: A practical broker operations system for reducing pipeline chaos, improving lead follow-up, organizing borrower documents, protecting sensitive workflows, and building a cleaner funding agency operating system.
pack.positioning: Not a generic AI tool pack. This is a funding broker workflow automation pack built around lead intake, CRM hygiene, document collection, deal summaries, referral partner follow-up, and human-reviewed lender-fit workflows.
pack.core_doctrine: Automate the admin. Assist the analysis. Human-review the money talk. Audit everything.
pack.secondary_cta_label: Explore the Moonshine Capital Partner Program
pack.compliance_note: Not lender, legal, tax, accounting, or underwriting advice. Approval is not guaranteed. Eligibility, terms, documentation requirements, and lender review vary. Human review required.
